en.title: quan — Taiwan Quant Research Toolkit
en.summary: Python research-to-paper-trading framework with Taiwan market data, cost-aware backtests, walk-forward validation, and Shioaji adapters.
en.challenge: Taiwan-market research needs consistent data, realistic costs, repeatable backtests, strong validation, and a safe path from strategy output to paper execution before any live deployment.
contribution: Designed a layered Python package and CLI for data preparation, strategy research, reporting, and broker-neutral execution.
Implemented Taiwan futures cost models, continuous-contract helpers, strategy comparison, parameter sweeps, and walk-forward validation.
Integrated paper execution and Shioaji adapters with market-hours, expiry, order-size, kill-switch, rate-limit, and reconciliation guards.
technical: Canonical OHLCV pipeline with Yahoo Finance, FinMind, TAIFEX, local CSV, and Shioaji real-time adapters.
Backtrader event-driven research with eleven strategy templates, external strategy loading, metrics, CSV/JSON reports, and SVG charts.
Target-position runtime separates strategy decisions from broker orders so the same logic can move from dry-run to simulation safely.

architecture.label: Market data
architecture.detail: Downloaders and adapters normalize OHLCV, futures contracts, calendars, and live ticks.

architecture.label: Research
architecture.detail: Strategies run through Backtrader with Taiwan-market costs, benchmarks, optimization, and walk-forward validation.

architecture.label: Decision
architecture.detail: Validated strategy output is converted into target positions rather than direct orders.

architecture.label: Execution
architecture.detail: Runtime guards, paper/Shioaji adapters, callbacks, reconciliation, and reports control downstream execution.

outcomes: Delivered a repeatable research-to-paper-trading foundation with automated tests and explicit safety boundaries.
Made strategies extensible without modifying the core package through scaffolding, config files, and external loading.
Documents limitations clearly: the framework is research infrastructure, not a claim of profitable or unattended live trading.

zh.title: quan — 台灣量化研究工具組
zh.summary: 從研究到模擬交易的 Python 框架，整合台灣市場資料、交易成本回測、滾動前推驗證與 Shioaji 介面。
zh.role: 量化研究與平台工程師
zh.challenge: 台灣市場研究需要一致資料、合理交易成本、可重複回測、嚴謹驗證，以及在正式上線前從策略輸出安全銜接至模擬交易的路徑。
contribution: 設計分層 Python 套件與命令列介面，涵蓋資料準備、策略研究、報告與券商中立的執行層。
實作台灣期貨成本模型、連續合約工具、策略比較、參數掃描與滾動前推驗證。
整合模擬執行與 Shioaji 介面，加入交易時段、到期日、下單量、緊急停止、速率限制與對帳防護。
technical: 標準 OHLCV 管線整合 Yahoo Finance、FinMind、TAIFEX、本地 CSV 與 Shioaji 即時資料介面。
以 Backtrader 進行事件驅動研究，提供十一種策略範本、外部策略載入、指標、CSV／JSON 報告與 SVG 圖表。
目標部位執行環境將策略決策與券商訂單分離，使同一邏輯能安全地從試跑移至模擬交易。

architecture.label: 市場資料
architecture.detail: 下載器與介面標準化 OHLCV、期貨合約、交易日曆與即時報價。

architecture.label: 研究
architecture.detail: 策略透過 Backtrader 執行，納入台灣市場成本、基準、最佳化與滾動前推驗證。

architecture.label: 決策
architecture.detail: 通過驗證的策略輸出會轉換為目標部位，而非直接產生訂單。

architecture.label: 執行
architecture.detail: 執行防護、模擬與 Shioaji 介面、回呼、對帳及報告共同控制後續交易。

outcomes: 交付可重複的研究至模擬交易基礎，包含自動化測試與明確安全邊界。
透過腳手架、設定檔與外部載入機制，使策略可擴充而不必修改核心套件。
清楚說明限制：此框架是研究基礎設施，不代表獲利保證或可無人監督進行實盤交易。
